title: Browse by name and discovery
summary: Genres, studios, people and years as browsable items; filter facets; similar items, recommendations and suggestions.

features.title: Genres, studios, people, years
features.description: `GET /Genres`, `/Studios`, `/Persons`, `/Years` and their single forms: distinct names carried by what the user may see, counts by type, name filters, paging; opened by id through `/Items/{id}`.
features.reference: Same lists; genre images are generated collages.
features.notes: Image slots are empty; a person nothing visible credits is 404 (the reference answers 200); `TotalRecordCount` of `/Years` is the number of years.

features.title: Filter facets
features.description: `/Items/Filters` (genres, tags, ratings, years of a parent) and `/Items/Filters2` (genres with ids, tags, audio languages).
features.reference: Also lists subtitle languages and uses the user's views.
features.notes: SubtitleLanguages is always empty; AudioLanguages only when item types are named.

features.title: Similar items
features.description: Movies and series ranked by the number of shared genres, studios, people and tags.
features.reference: Same idea; the reference's ranking of ties is not specified.

features.title: Movie recommendations and suggestions
features.description: Categories from the movies the user played last (similar, same director, same actor); a random sample of items as suggestions.
features.reference: Same category kinds (also liked-item categories); suggestions are an unspecified mix of everything.

features.title: Intros and collections of an item
features.description: `/Items/{id}/Intros` is empty (no pre-roll content exists); `/Items/{id}/Collections` lists the collections holding the item.

features.title: Favorites of genres, people and studios
features.description: Named items have no stored user data: they are never favorites and `IsFavorite` filters list nothing.
features.reference: A person or genre can be favorited.
features.notes: Needs a per-user store keyed by name rather than by item row.
